log.msg: CAUSE: ext/Doc/Doc.js's members() adds every method/property page ONLY as a child of the 'api' section (url .../api/<name>/), which does work cold - I proved it. The six urls in the brief (.../doc/method/<name>/, doc/property/<name>/) were never minted anywhere: no Page.child() route answers 'method' or 'property' under the 'doc' section, so App.load() throws its own 404 before any .md fetch happens - the .md file being served is unrelated, it is a static asset at a path that just happens to look like the missing route.

FIX (ext/Doc/Doc.js): member_page() now also records each method/property's config into a per-Doc member_index by kind, as it builds the existing api/<name>/ page. docs_section() now creates the 'doc' node whenever a module has notes OR members (not notes alone) and gives it route('method'|'property') -> member_group(kind), a lazy container whose own route(name) looks the name up in member_index and builds the identical page a second time at doc/method/<name>/ or doc/property/<name>/. Purely additive: api/<name>/ is untouched, and render()/bar() were changed so the visible Docs tab still lists ONLY real notes - a module gains no new visible tab, it just answers a second address.

PROOF: the six urls from the brief (core/Page x5, core/App x1) load cold (fresh Playwright tab, no prior nav) with correct titles and zero console errors. Enumerated every Doc site-wide from its methods:/properties: declaration (29 modules, 379 member names) and crawled every doc/method/<name>/ and doc/property/<name>/ at 1280x900 cold: 379/379 render (title correct, no 'Page Load Error'). N (real routing 404s) -> 0. A handful (7) show a graceful 'Not written yet' for a missing .md - a pre-existing content gap identical on the old api/<name>/ address (verified side by side, e.g. core/Page depth, ext/Panel/Workspace saver), not a routing defect and not introduced here.

styles/ is confirmed a plain Page, not a Doc (public/framework/styles/page.js). Its readme.md links to styles/doc/*.md (cascade, ownership, theme, stacking, layout-system, audits, scrolling, measure, decisions) as raw .md file links - all 9 exist and serve 200. This is the SAME intentional pattern ext/Doc's own readme.md uses for its own doc/decisions.md etc (a background/decision record with no page route, documented as deliberate in ext/markdown/md.js:151-165). No readme.md change made: nothing is broken, and forcing these onto /rules/<name>/ or /layers/<name>/ would be wrong since those pages cover different, narrower content (dos/don'ts and layer tokens, not the cascade/ownership rationale). Left as is; noting it here per the brief's 'say so'.

Left: a member added via a prefixed SECOND subject (readme.md's own documented override pattern, this.members(section, History, {prefix: 'History.'})) is not exercised anywhere on the live site today, so the fix's member_index-based aliasing is untested on that path - it should alias the same way (nothing in the code special-cases the default subject) but I did not construct a synthetic module to prove it, to stay inside budget. Also left: 7 missing doc/property|method .md files found during the crawl (core/Page depth; ext/Panel/Workspace saver, root, zoom, mode, viewports, $view, $roots) - pre-existing content gaps outside this task's fence (ext/Doc/** only, never core/** or ext/Panel/**).

assign.outcome:
**A Doc member page now opens from either of its two addresses, cold.** `ext/Doc/Doc.js`'s `members()` always built a method/property page at `/api/<name>/` (the tab) — that address always worked. But its own `.md` file lives at `doc/method/<name>.md` / `doc/property/<name>.md`, the same address style prose across the whole site links from, and nothing ever registered a PAGE there — `Page.child()` had no route for `method`/`property` under a Doc's `doc` section, so the router 404'd before any file was ever fetched (the `.md` being served was a red herring — that part always worked).

**Fix:** `member_page()` now records each member into a `member_index` map by kind as it builds the existing `/api/<name>/` page; `docs_section()` builds the `doc` node whenever a module has notes OR members (not notes alone) and gives it `route("method"|"property")`, a lazy container that looks the name up in `member_index` and builds the same page a second time. Purely additive — `/api/<name>/` is untouched, and the visible "Docs" tab still lists only real notes, so no module gained a tab it didn't have.

**Proof.** The six cited urls load cold with correct titles and zero console errors. Enumerated every Doc's `methods:`/`properties:` declaration site-wide (29 modules, 379 member names) and crawled every `doc/method/<name>/` and `doc/property/<name>/` at 1280 cold: **379/379 render, 0 routing failures** (N → 0). Seven show a graceful "Not written yet" for a genuinely missing `.md` — a pre-existing content gap, identical on the old `/api/<name>/` address, not a routing defect.

**styles/** is a plain `Page`, not a `Doc`. Its readme's links to `styles/doc/*.md` are raw file links (all 9 exist, serve 200) — the same deliberate pattern `ext/Doc`'s own readme uses for its own `doc/decisions.md`. Nothing there is broken; left as-is rather than force-mapped onto `/rules/` or `/layers/` pages that cover different content.

**Left:** a member added via a second, prefixed subject (the `History` pattern named in `Doc.js`'s own comment) isn't exercised live anywhere, so the fix's aliasing is untested on that specific path (it should generalize — nothing special-cases the default subject — but wasn't proven with a synthetic module). Also left, outside this fence: seven pre-existing missing `doc/method|property/*.md` files (`core/Page` depth; `ext/Panel/Workspace` saver/root/zoom/mode/viewports/$view/$roots).
